author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's a look at the Scourge of the Reptiles announcement trailer for this upcoming party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric low-fantasy world where magic, war, and colossal beasts collide. The Scourge of the Reptiles trailer showcases gameplay, tactical combat, dinosaurs, and a peek at the story.

In Scourge of the Reptiles, a devastating meteor grants magical abilities to humans, elves, and dinosaurs alike, triggering conflict across kingdoms and unleashing a threat that spreads far beyond the hero’s quiet beginnings. As dinosaurs begin to turn against their masters, players must assemble a party, build strength in the wilderness, and uncover the source of this growing chaos.
title: Scourge of the Reptiles - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Modulus: Factory Automation is available now on PC via Steam. Watch the Modulus: Factory Automation launch trailer for this creative sandbox factory simulation game where you don’t just solve problems, you design the components that make up the solution. In Modulus: Factory Automation, build and automate elegant production systems using modular engineering tools: cut, paint, stamp, and assemble 3D building blocks called modules. From logic-driven problem solving to free-form expression, Modulus: Factory Automation blends base-building, resource management, and thoughtful strategy in a game that rewards both beauty and efficiency. There’s no single solution, only the system you create.
title: Modulus: Factory Automation - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Shinobi: Art of Vengeance for the action platformer game to see gameplay from the upcoming Sega Villains Stage DLC. In the Sega Villains Stage DLC, Joe Musashi will battle classic SEGA Villains - Majima, the mad dog of Shimano from the Yakuza/Like a Dragon series; Dr. Eggman, the evil genius from the Sonic the Hedgehog series; and Death Adder, the ruthless giant from Golden Axe. 

The Sega Villains Stage DLC includes 5 stages, 3 bosses (Majima, Dr. Eggman, and Death Adder), 3 ninpos, 3 skins, 6 music tracks inspired by each Sega Villain IP, and 2 Boss Rush Modes featuring the new bosses.

The Sega Villains Stage DLC for Shinobi: Art of Vengeance will be available on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and Steam on April 3, 2026.
title: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance - Official SEGA Villains Stage DLC Gameplay Trailer

description:
Watch this latest gameplay from Exodus in this new video for the upcoming sci-fi RPG. The new gameplay video for Exodus gives a peek into a distant, frozen world, as the character explores crystal cave passages alongside companions Salt the Octopus and Elise. Check out a vast vista overlooking icy monuments and architecture that is unmistakably alien. Extended gameplay will be revealed in summer 2026.

Exodus will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

Exodus is a sci-fi action-adventure RPG where you become the Traveler—leading humanity’s fight for survival against the Celestials. Face our evolution 40,000 years in the future, explore extraordinary worlds, and confront time itself to shape the fate of generations.​
title: Exodus - Official 'Exploring A Distant Frozen World' Gameplay Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Ascenders: Beyond The Peak announcement trailer for this upcoming exploration roguelite blending turn-based climbing and expedition management, with rope physics, and permanent consequences. Ascenders: Beyond The Peak will be available in Steam Early Access in Q3 2026.

In Ascenders: Beyond The Peak, the difference between life and death is your ability to read the mountain and choose your next move wisely. As the team leader, players will face moral choices as they climb a mountain cursed with mysterious Lovecraftian threats hidden within the rock — every loss irrevocably reshaping your roster. Every expedition is a desperate attempt to reach the summit, understand the forces shaping the mountain, and return alive with the knowledge and artefacts you need for your next ascent. At all costs, your mission is to forbid them from falling into the wrong hands. Death after death, players will learn to turn the environment into a weapon, mastering each ascent through
title: Ascenders: Beyond The Peak - Official Announcement Trailer
